"""Preserve genuinely executed final-preview checks and dated visual samples."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
site = json.loads((root / 'outputs/final-preview-site-check.json').read_text())
assert site['status'] == 'passed'
assert all(sha((root / path).read_bytes()) == digest for path, digest in site['source_sha256'].items())
records = []
for name, source in [
    ('final-preview-export.json', 'outputs/final-preview-site-check.json'),
    ('final-preview-browser-pages.json', 'outputs/browser-layout/final-review-all-pages.json'),
    ('final-preview-browser-interactions.json', 'outputs/browser-layout/final-review-interactions.json'),
]:
    raw = (root / source).read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert data['status'] == 'passed'
    if 'build_info' in data:
        assert data['build_info']['revision'] == site['revision']
    if name.endswith('browser-pages.json'):
        assert data['page_count'] == 256 and data['viewport_count'] == 2 and len(data['records']) == 512
        assert not data['failures'] and not data['runtime_errors']
    target = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts' / name
    assert not target.exists()
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    records.append({'source': source, 'preserved': target.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'original_checked_at': data['checked_at']})

unchanged_figures = []
for name in ['review-preview-svg-motion.json', 'review-preview-svg-bounds.json']:
    path = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts' / name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert data['status'] in ['pass', 'passed']
    for item in data['records']:
        figure = item.get('source', item.get('figure'))
        digest = item.get('source_sha256', item.get('sha256'))
        assert sha((root / figure).read_bytes()) == digest
    unchanged_figures.append({'path': path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'original_checked_at': data.get('checked_at', data.get('checkedAt')), 'scope': 'Read-only comparison with unchanged SVG bytes. The actual original browser/render dates remain intact; these checks were not rerun today at this preview revision.'})

visual_path = root / 'outputs/final-preview-visual-inspection.json'
visual = json.loads(visual_path.read_bytes())
assert visual['revision'] == site['revision'] and visual['status'] == 'passed'
assert visual['records']
for item in visual['records']:
    assert item['actual_viewed_at'] and item['observation']
    assert sha(Path(item['screenshot']).read_bytes()) == item['screenshot_sha256']
receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'checked_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'passed',
    'checkout_head_at_preservation': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    'preview_revision': site['revision'],
    'scope': 'Exact copies of actual final-preview export and512 desktop/mobile browser checks after all248 independent technical results closed. Current book, rendering, notebook and SVG bytes were compared. Root visual samples are explicitly bounded, original unchanged SVG dates are retained. This is not remote Colab execution, real-device student testing, a new GPU training run, an invoice, or published-main verification. A later docs-only commit changes the immutable preview pin but not these verified source bytes.',
    'records': records, 'unchanged_svg_evidence': unchanged_figures,
    'actual_root_visual_samples': visual['records'], 'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
target = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts/final-preview-evidence.json'
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'preview_revision': site['revision'], 'preserved_checks': len(records), 'visual_samples': len(visual['records'])}))
